title: 第436章 公然袭击第435章 以史为鉴
slug: 天神传说第438章改革开始
content_zh:
长渊宗大殿之内，一片死寂。
苏少卿故作淡然的坐在宗主之位上，实则内心早已经掀起万丈波澜。
五位长老在听完苏少卿的话后，内心都彼此心照不宣。
“各位长老，你们不说话，我就当是默认了。”苏少卿知道自己必须做出这一步。
果然，此话一出，李默言瞬间坐不住了。
“苏少卿，我敬你三分，喊你一声宗主，但你可不要得寸进尺，你不过是个毛头小子，化海都没有的普通弟子，你真以为自己是条龙啊，仗着自己立下一些功劳，就敢在这里耀武扬威，妄议长渊宗存亡，若是没有哲，你算个屁啊！”李默言站起身指着苏少卿的鼻子骂道。
“放肆！三弟！怎敢直呼宗主姓名！跪下！”谢广鹏起身看着李默言怒道。
“哼，大哥，这小子要让长渊宗灭宗，要是长渊宗没了，我李默言也不活了，老子第一个杀了这个长渊宗的叛徒！”李默言说完，周身武气就已经开始隐隐运转。
“你敢！”谢广鹏运转武气，威压直压向李默言。
“大哥，三弟所言，有理。”
一股柔和的威压将谢广鹏的威压缓缓化解，秦玉霜站起身看向苏少卿。
“宗主，此战长渊宗出力最多，虽说统一一事我长渊宗理亏，但实力至上也并无大碍，我们如此放低姿态去迎合他们，未免有些太窝囊，更何况，也会寒了长渊宗诸多弟子的心啊。”秦玉霜道。
“宗主创造出渊灵甲，还设计出了暴风雷霆这样的大杀器，在此战中也是立下了赫赫战功，但是，宗主，哲用武力逼迫所有人臣服，宗主有什么。”温然语气轻飘飘的看着苏少卿，仿佛自己是在与苏少卿聊闲话。
“宗主，你此番决定，未免让我们长渊宗落了下乘，只怕会长他人志气啊。”赵磊道。
“你，你们！”
谢广鹏很聪明，他知道苏少卿的做法才有可能实现真正的和平，但对于长渊宗的归属感让谢广鹏在刚才的某一刻，真的想要反对苏少卿的决定。
他知道几位长老都是为长渊宗考虑，他一时之间竟然无话可说。
“大长老。”
一双手轻轻放到谢广鹏的肩膀上，谢广鹏回头看去，是苏少卿。
苏少卿点头示意谢广鹏坐回去，谢广鹏见状，虽然还想维护一下苏少卿，但终究还是无话可说。

李默言看着站起来的苏少卿，轻蔑的笑了笑，在他的眼里，苏少卿翻不起什么浪花。
“李默言，你刚才说，我没有哲，算个屁，是吗。”苏少卿看着李默言冷道。
“难道不是吗。”李默言冷哼一声道。
“李默言，在场的是所有人都有资格说我，但唯有你，还不配。”苏少卿盯着李默言的眼睛，眼中的竟然浮现一丝，那一瞬间，李默言的后背竟然突然冒起一丝冷汗。
“李默言，在场的每一个人，甚至外面的弟子，都在此战立下了功劳，但唯独你，非但没有立功，甚至还加害于白夜卫，其罪当诛，如若不是大长老保你，你现在还能坐在这里义愤填膺。”苏少卿的声音不高，但不知为何，却如此震耳欲聋，让在场众人的心都瞬间颤了一下。
“你胡说，我对长渊宗的心，日月可鉴，你身为宗主，却满嘴胡言，胡搅蛮缠，简直是长渊宗的耻辱。”李默言怒道。
“他乱了。”
在场的其他人心里同时响起一句话。
content_en:
There was deathly silence in the Changyuan Sect's main hall.
Su Shaoqing pretended to be calm and sat in the position of the sect leader, but in fact, his heart was already in turmoil.
After listening to Su Shaoqing's words, the five elders all understood each other tacitly.
"Elders, if you don't speak, I will take it as acquiescence." Su Shaoqing knew that he had to make this step.
Sure enough, as soon as these words came out, Li Moyan couldn't sit still.
"Su Shaoqing, I respect you three points and call you sect master, but you must not push yourself too far. You are just a young boy, an ordinary disciple who has not even transformed into the sea. You really think you are a dragon. You dare to show off your power here and presumptuously preside over the survival of the Yuan Sect just because you have made some achievements. If you don't have philosophy, you are nothing!" Li Moyan stood up and pointed at Su Shaoqing's nose and cursed.
"How dare you! Third brother! How dare you call the sect leader by his name! Kneel down!" Xie Guangpeng stood up and looked at Li Moyan and said angrily.
"Humph, brother, this kid wants to destroy the Chang Yuan Sect. If the Chang Yuan Sect is gone, I, Li Moyan, will not be alive either. I will be the first to kill this traitor of the Chang Yuan Sect!" After Li Moyan finished speaking, the martial energy around him began to circulate faintly.
"How dare you!" Xie Guangpeng circulated his martial energy and pressed towards Li Moyan with coercion.
"Brother, what the third brother said makes sense."
A gentle pressure slowly dissolved Xie Guangpeng's pressure, and Qin Yushuang stood up and looked at Su Shaoqing.
"Sect Master, the Changyuan Sect contributed the most in this battle. Although we, the Changyuan Sect, are in the wrong regarding the unification, it does not matter if we put strength first. It would be too cowardly for us to lower our posture to cater to them, not to mention that it would also chill the hearts of many disciples of the Changyuan Sect." Qin Yushuang said.
"The sect master created the Yuanling Armor, and also designed such a powerful weapon as the Storm and Thunder, and also made great achievements in this battle. However, the sect master, Zhe, used force to force everyone to surrender. What does the sect master have?" Wen Ran looked at Su Shaoqing with a light tone, as if he was chatting with Su Shaoqing.
"Sect Master, your decision will inevitably put our Changyuan Sect at a disadvantage, and I'm afraid it will only increase the ambition of others." Zhao Lei said.
"You, you guys!"
Xie Guangpeng is very smart. He knows that Su Shaoqing's approach can achieve real peace, but his sense of belonging to Changyuan Sect made Xie Guangpeng really want to oppose Su Shaoqing's decision at a certain moment just now.
He knew that several elders were thinking about Changyuan Sect, but he was speechless for a moment.
"Great Elder."
A pair of hands was gently placed on Xie Guangpeng's shoulders. Xie Guangpeng looked back and saw that it was Su Shaoqing.
Su Shaoqing nodded and motioned for Xie Guangpeng to sit back. When Xie Guangpeng saw this, although he still wanted to defend Su Shaoqing, he still had nothing to say.
Li Moyan looked at Su Shaoqing who stood up and smiled contemptuously. In his eyes, Su Shaoqing couldn't make any waves.
"Li Moyan, you just said that I don't have wisdom, so it's nothing, right?" Su Shaoqing looked at Li Moyan and said coldly.
"Isn't it?" Li Moyan snorted coldly.
"Li Moyan, everyone here is qualified to speak against me, but you are the only one who is not worthy." Su Shaoqing stared into Li Moyan's eyes, and there was something in his eyes. At that moment, a cold sweat suddenly broke out on Li Moyan's back.
"Li Moyan, everyone here, and even the disciples outside, have made contributions in this battle, but you are the only one who has not made any contributions, but has even harmed the White Night Guards. You should be punished for your crime. If it weren't for the Great Elder to protect you, you would still be sitting here filled with righteous indignation." Su Shaoqing's voice was not high, but for some reason, it was so deafening that the hearts of everyone present instantly trembled.
"You are talking nonsense. My feelings towards Chang Yuan Sect can be seen from the sun and the moon. As the sect leader, you are full of nonsense and messy. It is simply a shame for Chang Yuan Sect." Li Moyan said angrily.
"He's messed up."
A sentence echoed in the hearts of other people present at the same time.
